messages:
alex: PRD intake — cold-start tail latency for Dedicated GPU pools. Need to capture problem, goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, edge cases. cc @kevin @sarah
kevin: scope? GPUs only or include CPU-backed reserved nodes?
maria: GPUs only for initial rollout (A100/V100). We see large tail after idle/scale-up.
sarah: customer impact note: two customers hit request timeouts during warmups this month (CS-882, CS-889).
alex: problem statement: first-token p95/p99 spikes after idle >10s or on new allocation causing visible UX regressions.
alex: goals: 1) reduce p95 cold-start to <300ms, 2) p99 <700ms for typical 8k seq workload, 3) cost delta <5% GPU-hours.
alex: non-goals: changing model weights, mandatory customer changes, or supporting private on-prem in first ship.
maria: current observations: profiling shows model load + kernel jitting + CUDA context init as main contributors — p95 ~= 1.2s, p99 ~= 2.4s on A100 under test.
kevin: acceptance criteria (draft):
- end-to-end p95 measured from request->first-token <=300ms across 3 staging tenants over 1h test (99% sample)
- p99 <=700ms in same run
- no more than 5% GPU-hour increase in steady-state
sarah: rollout plan: canary 5% dedicated capacity, measure: tail latency, timeout_count, GPU mem usage, infra errors. automatic rollback if timeouts spike >200% vs baseline.
maria: proposed mechanism ideas: lightweight persistent kernel cache + async pre-warm on allocation; keep a tiny warm-pool of preloaded workers per model variant.
kevin: ops concerns: warm pool increases memory/GPU footprints. Need eviction policy and tenant-tier priority (paid tenants first).
alex: success metrics: p95 <300ms, p99 <700ms, <1 user-reported timeout/week for targeted customers, and cost delta under threshold.
sarah: edge cases to call out:
- warm fails due to OOM on large models
- warm after model rollout/version change (cache invalidation)
- multiple tenants evicting each other when capacity tight
maria: test harness snippet for acceptance (pseudo):
```
for tenant in tenants:
  idle(30s)
  send_requests(1000, concurrency=4)
  assert p95 < 300ms
```
kevin: I'll add cost model + autoscale policy changes to RFC. (Will list worst-case memory delta per model class).
maria: I'll draft RFC including perf numbers, kernel-cache design, and failure modes. ETA: EOD Thu.
kevin: ETA for cost/risk section: next Mon.
alex: CS: we'll schedule test windows with the two affected customers. Maria, please include test harness and telemetry requirements.
ops-bot: Note created: GH issue #4567 — cold-start-reduction-dedicated
sarah: Q: private deployments? they may have different constraints (no shared warm pools).
alex: private deployments out of scope for initial rollout; document as follow-up work.
maria: risks list will include: driver/CUDA variability, model-specific warmup jitter, container startup time, and JIT variance.
kevin: prioritization note: high ROI for Dedicated enterprise customers -> suggests P1 for next quarter if RFC shows minimal cost delta.
alex: next steps: maria to open RFC, kevin to attach cost model + rollback plan, sres to define observability/alerts. Reconvene Tue 10am for RFC review.
sarah: calendar invite sent.
kevin: thumbs up.
maria: :thumbsup: starting RFC now.
alex: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the intake doc.
